entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Introduce Attach operator for source generator pipeline triggering incremental output driven by only one source (instead of either like Combine) #79322
  • HR fails when removing a property with an initializer from a partial class #79320
  • SyntaxGenerator is missing a few operator expression kinds #79314
  • Inferred variable initializer should attempt to resolve extension before trying to infer natural function type #79309
  • Reenable IDE0051 in src/Compilers/.editorconfig #79306
  • CSharpNewDocumentFormatting.CreateLegacyProjectWithFileScopedNamespaces failing due to error list #79302
  • CSharpInteractiveDirectives.WorkspaceClearedAfterReset failing due to locale mismatch #79301
  • BasicRename.VerifyAttributeNotCapitalizedRename fails despite try/catch #79300

Closed

  • Prevent IDE0305 when ambiguous overloads exist #79312
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ResxSourceGenerator has strange pre-release tag #79310
